data.name: Actions.RefreshUsage.Description
data.value: Polls Windsurf for the latest usage figures immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled refresh.

data.name: Actions.RefreshUsage.Failure
data.value: Could not reach Windsurf. Sign in to the Windsurf IDE, the Windsurf JetBrains plugin or Devin Desktop on this machine.

data.name: Variables.DailyUsed.Description
data.value: Percent of the daily Windsurf quota already used.

data.name: Variables.WeeklyUsed.Description
data.value: Percent of the weekly Windsurf quota already used.

data.name: Variables.ExtraBalance.Description
data.value: The remaining extra usage balance in dollars.

data.name: Variables.Plan.Description
data.value: The name of the active Windsurf plan.

data.name: Variables.LastUpdate.Description
data.value: When the usage figures were last refreshed.

data.name: Variables.PlanReset.Description
data.value: When the Windsurf plan resets, as a date and time.

data.name: Variables.PlanDaysLeft.Description
data.value: Days until the Windsurf plan resets.

data.name: Variables.DailyReset.Description
data.value: When the daily quota resets, as a date and time.

data.name: Variables.WeeklyReset.Description
data.value: When the weekly quota resets, as a date and time.

data.name: Variables.Email.Description
data.value: The email address the plugin is signed in with.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Description
data.value: Arc and ring gauges for any numeric variables, with the value and label drawn inside the ring and a title that supports variables.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.EmptyHint
data.value: Add a gauge in this widget's settings.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Title.Description
data.value: Shown above the gauges. Supports variables, for example Windsurf {{ vars.windsurf_plan }}.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.FullHint
data.value: This widget holds at most 8 gauges. Remove one to add another.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.NameHint
data.value: Drawn inside the ring above the value. Supports variables, for example {{ vars.windsurf_plan }}. When set, the icon is not drawn.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.MaximumHint
data.value: 0 means automatic: the variable's declared maximum, or minimum plus 100.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.ColorThresholdsDescription
data.value: Colour the ring by which band the value falls into.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.WarningHint
data.value: Turn the ring red when the value crosses the threshold.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.ValueSizeHint
data.value: The value's font size as a percentage of the tile height. The default is 22.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.LabelSizeHint
data.value: The inside label's font size as a percentage of the tile height. The default is 11.

data.name: Widgets.Gauge.Config.Fields.ValueSuffixHint
data.value: Drawn right after the value, for example %. Supports variables.

data.name: Config.Polling.Description
data.value: How often the plugin polls Windsurf for fresh usage figures.

data.name: Config.Polling.Field.Description
data.value: Between 30 and 3600 seconds. The default is 300 (five minutes).

data.name: Config.Polling.Field.Invalid
data.value: Enter a number of seconds between 30 and 3600.
